title: Example27 labels the eliminated atoms as the retained vocabulary.
details: In arXiv:2508.11449v3 §9.1 Example27, printed pp.15–16, the source asks for a uniform {a,d}-interpolant of ¬(d∧e)∧(a→d)∧(a∨c)∧e, eliminates d and then a, and labels e∧(c∨¬e), equivalently e∧c, a uniform {a,d}-interpolant. The conclusion has atoms c,e outside the claimed retained vocabulary, so it fails Definition10. The calculation correctly forgets a,d and retains {c,e}; change both stated retained vocabularies to {c,e}. If retaining {a,d} is intended instead, the original formula is equivalent to e∧¬d∧¬a∧c, whose projection is ¬a∧¬d. This is a local vocabulary-label slip; the displayed resolvents and projection argument survive. No upstream correction observed. The new corpus treatment will use its own correctly scoped example.
